plan.notes: Transcribed 2026-11-14 from the official University of Washington Bothell degree-map PDF 'B-Earth-System-Science-Degree-Map-2022.pdf' (printed footer 'Last updated: 9/22/2022'), hosted on uwb.edu. Filed under catalog_year 2022-2023: this is an ARCHIVED map, not the current catalog. The current UW Bothell catalog is 2026-2027, and the degree maps the site currently links to are UW NetID SharePoint Word documents and MyPlan, both login-walled; no login was attempted, so the public 2022 PDF is the newest publicly verifiable official term-by-term map for this program. The map calls itself 'a suggested schedule of courses based on degree requirements' and 'not a substitute for academic advising' (printed on the map). UW Bothell is a quarter-system school; the 12 blocks below are the map's 12 quarters (Autumn/Winter/Spring, Years 1-4) in printed order. The map prints no per-term totals and no degree total. No parenthetical credit number is printed anywhere on this map (the printed '(F)' fieldwork marker and '(min 2.0)' / '(min 2.5)' grade notes are not credit numbers), so under the printed rule every slot is 5 credits, each quarter sums to 15 and the plan to 180, the standard UW Bothell bachelor's total. Markers printed on the map are disclosed, not recorded as prerequisites (the map prints no course-to-course prerequisite chain, so no prereqs are recorded): the solid diamond means 'Prerequisite: Must be completed prior to applying for a major'; the checkmark means 'Milestones: Courses and special requirements necessary to timely progress through and complete a major'; the star means 'See list of choices' — those lists are not printed on the map, so star-marked slots list no options; the four-point marker means 'May be fulfilled with Discovery Core'; '(F)' means '5 credits of fieldwork required'. The map prints no course titles for BIS 342 or BEARTH 300; they are recorded as 'no title printed on the degree map' rather than sourced elsewhere. The combined science choice cell printed in Year 1 Winter and again in Year 2 Autumn — 'B CHEM 143/144 OR B PHYS 114 & 117 OR BPHYS 121 & 117' — is recorded verbatim as a choice slot in both quarters (separate synthetic codes). Other printed choice cells are recorded with exactly the printed options: 'BIS 215 or STMATH 341' (Year 2 Winter) and 'BES 301 or BST 301' (Year 3 Winter). 'Earth Systems Science Course' (twice), 'Additional Foundational Science' (three times), 'Earth System Science Focus' (four times, once with the (F) marker), 'Approved Capstone Research' (twice) and the other generic category slots are transcribed with their printed wording as choice slots with unique synthetic codes.
